messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High rate of cross-region health-check flips detected between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Fallback loop triggered; >15% of routed requests hit fallback within 30s. Auto-page oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: got it, I'm up. seeing constant probe timeouts 502 -> 200 -> 502. routing policy shows cascade fallbacks (eu -> us-west -> us-east) with TTL 10s.

alex: trying to correlate with model rollout — any recent variant promotions?
maya: yes, we rolled quantized-1.8 into eu canary this morning as a lower-cost fallback. It should be only for cost-tiered traffic, but looks like policy is picking it as compatible fallback for all variants.
samir: that would explain higher 500s — quantized-1.8 is missing a custom op, runtime returns 502 on some sequences. Not compatible.
maureen: paging customers in affected regions — support sees increased 5xx and latency for embeddings and chat endpoints for Dedicated and some Hosted requests pinned to eu.
support-lead: opening customer bridge for top 5 affected accounts. ETA for mitigation?
oncall-sre: immediate mitigation: disable cross-region fallback in routing policy, force local failover only, and pin eu traffic to fallback-to: none. Applying now.
eng-runtime: hold — we need to avoid making things worse. Suggest instead temporary route: set fallback_variant to model-stable-v2 instead of quantized-1.8, and increase health-check grace to 45s to dampen flapping.
oncall-sre: making quick change: patching policy. command:
```
redwoodctl routing update --policy-id r-abc123 \
  --set 'fallback_variant=model-stable-v2' \
  --set 'cross_region_fallback=false' \
  --set 'health_grace_period=45'
```

alex: logs while this applied:
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] policy:update r-abc123 by oncall-sre
[2026-03-15T14:12:05Z] routing:apply success
[2026-03-15T14:12:06Z] probe:eu->us-west health delta reduced
```
maya: confirmation from probes: eu health now stable, no new fallbacks observed in last 2m. Error rate trending down from 12% -> 2%.

maureen: support note: customer A (enterprise-dedicated-eu) reported degraded embeddings at 13:55 UTC; they are back to normal now. I'll send a postmortem note and temporary RCA.
support-lead: please add mitigation steps and ETA for permanent fix to the ticket.

samir: root cause summary: policy mismatch allowed cost-fallback variant (quantized-1.8) to be considered compatible for production model family. That variant has known op-compatibility gaps causing intermittent 502s under specific token patterns. Combined with low TTL on health-checks caused rapid probe flips and cross-region fallback churn.
oncall-sre: oncall handoff in 20m to eng-runtime for follow-through. leaving notes in pagerduty.
eng-runtime: taking over for continuous monitoring. next steps: 1) Add policy validation to prevent incompatible variant from being an automatic fallback. 2) Add variant capability metadata to model catalog used by router. 3) Increase default health grace period in routing policy templates. 4) Run targeted test of quantized-1.8 for compatibility.

maureen: I'll coordinate customer comms and flag customers for follow-up.
support-lead: agreed. Also prepare list of Dedicated tenants who had cross-region failovers in the last 24h.

alex: recording timeline for postmortem: 14:05 UTC probe jitter starts; 14:08 quantized-1.8 promoted to canary; 14:11 routing policy TTL causes failover loop; 14:12 patch applied to disable cross-region fallback and switch fallback_variant; 14:15 error rate subsided.

incident-bot: Incident severity set to P1. Pager entries created: PD-5489. On-call handoff scheduled to eng-runtime at 14:30 UTC.

oncall-sre: thumbs-up, leaving handoff doc: "patched routing policy to stop cross-region fallback; pinned fallback to model-stable-v2; increased health grace; monitoring 30m for regression".

eng-runtime: acknowledged. I'll own the follow-ups and schedule the postmortem. tagging @research to run compatibility tests on quantized-1.8 variants.

maureen: thanks all. small action: support will send a short apology + summary to affected customers and offer extended logs.

samir: long-term fix note: router must consult model-compatibility matrix before selecting fallback variants. adding ticket to infra backlog.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Monitoring green for 12m, will continue to poll. If any new fallbacks observed, this thread will reopen.
